overview_description.description: WeFi is a blockchain-based decentralized finance (DeFi) and on-chain banking platform designed to bridge traditional financial services with the Web3 ecosystem. The platform enables users to access crypto-backed loans, leverage trading, staking, yield generation, and decentralized banking services through secure smart contracts and non-custodial infrastructure. WeFi supports on-chain accounts, crypto payment cards, lending and borrowing markets, and leveraged investment products integrated with DeFi protocols such as AAVE. Its mission is to create a transparent, user-controlled financial ecosystem where users can manage fiat and crypto assets seamlessly while benefiting from decentralized security, lower funding costs, and global accessibility.
